description: Find airdrop farms: every listed farm hottest first, with heat 0-100, EARLY, its chip (POINTS LIVE, TOKEN CONFIRMED, TGE ..., TESTNET), whether the agent runs it end to end (agent_runs) or it is coming soon and why, and its estimate per $1,000; with amount_usdc also the best split of that amount over the farms the agent runs and the six-month estimate range. From EventTrader's Airdrop Farmer (cymetica.com/airdrop-farmer): one amount split across airdrop farms of protocols with no token yet; a farm is listed only after its token has no market and its own points or testnet page was read with the programme running. One farm wallet per person, never pooled; the owner's own coins pay every fee. No airdrop is promised.
name: airdrop_farm_farms
title: Airdrop Farm Farms
